races.paceDynamic: Goomah sits as the only confirmed front-runner and will dictate a sustainable early pace without pressure from fellow prominent runner Halon Bay. The majority field of hold-up horses including Valentino Eclipse, Khafar, Carmel Valley, Connecteo, Cosmic Funk and Threebiggulps creates a compressed pack tracking the leaders. With no early speed battle expected, Goomah can control fractions and kick clear, while the mass of closers may struggle for racing room in the straight. This pace scenario strongly favours prominent runners and early positioning over hold-up tactics.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Goomah Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Goomah establishes uncontested lead and maintains steady fractions
scenarios.body: Goomah dictates comfortable splits and has enough left to repel late challenges, with Halon Bay tracking in ideal position to strike. The hold-up brigade gets caught in traffic as the pace quickens entering the straight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Tells Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely allowing closers optimal conditions
scenarios.body: Valentino Eclipse and Khafar get perfect setups to unleash superior class from off the pace despite the tactical disadvantage. The sustained kick from these higher-rated horses overwhelms the early leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Halon Bay or unknown quantities press Goomah early creating genuine speed
scenarios.body: The unexpected pace battle sets up perfectly for Cosmic Funk and Carmel Valley to close strongly from midfield positions. Both leaders weaken significantly in the final furlong after the speed engagement.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Longshot Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses show early speed creating chaotic early fractions
scenarios.body: The race completely falls apart tactically with several horses going too fast early, allowing outsiders like Gilts or Threebiggulps to pick up the pieces. Favorites get compromised by poor positioning or excessive early pace.

watchPoints.text: Goomah breaks slowly or gets pressed early which completely changes the pace dynamic
Valentino Eclipse shows early speed unlike expected hold-up style giving race more pace
Track bias develops favoring inside or outside draws affecting positioning advantages
Halon Bay adopts aggressive tactics and challenges Goomah for early lead
Weather changes affecting the good going before post time

races.paceDynamic: Cannes emerges as the sole natural front-runner with Almazann and Antigua likely to press from prominent positions early. The sustainable pace Cannes sets will not be pressured given the lack of other confirmed pace angles, creating a measured gallop that should suit patient types. Glen Echo, Mighty Wave and Amethyst Stone will need to be produced late from hold-up positions as the tempo builds gradually. This race shape heavily favours horses that can stay on strongly, with hold-up runners getting the tactical advantage from the controlled early fractions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Runners Thrive
scenarios.trigger: If Cannes sets uncontested fractions and the pace stays steady throughout
scenarios.body: The measured gallop plays into the hands of horses held up for late runs, with plenty of horse left for the final surge. Glen Echo and Mighty Wave benefit most from getting the trip and having something to aim at.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Almazann or Antigua can track the pace without being asked for effort
scenarios.body: A horse in the perfect stalking position can kick clear when Cannes weakens, having saved ground and energy. Almazann's proven form edge gives him the clearest chance from this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Cannes Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runner gets easy sectionals and has enough left for the finish
scenarios.body: His uncontested lead allows him to dictate throughout and possibly steal the race if his recent form translates to stamina improvement. The lack of early pressure becomes his biggest asset in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomers Deliver Class
scenarios.trigger: If Count Bezukhov or Dunmore show superior ability on debut despite tactical disadvantage
scenarios.body: The O'Brien and Mullins newcomers overcome positioning to win on raw talent alone. Their connections' strike rates with debutantes provide the only realistic path to victory from difficult draws.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Cannes gets seriously challenged early as he may not have the stamina reserves to respond over this trip
Monitor Count Bezukhov and Dunmore in the market as any support suggests superior home work from top connections
Glen Echo needs to be produced with a patient ride given his tendency to fade when asked for sustained effort
Almazann's positioning will be crucial as he needs to avoid getting trapped behind the slow pace
Watch for any late market moves on the O'Brien and Mullins newcomers as insider confidence often shows

races.paceDynamic: Signora has the lead to herself as the sole recognized front-runner, allowing her to dictate a sustainable gallop without early pressure. The real congestion develops behind with City Of Memphis, Carla Ridge, Quebec and Duckadilly all wanting prominent positions, creating inevitable traffic problems when the field bunches 2-3 furlongs out. With one pacemaker controlling the tempo and multiple prominent runners forced to compromise positions, this race shape clearly favors the hold-up horses who can stay out of trouble and deliver their challenge late when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominant
scenarios.trigger: If Signora sets honest fractions and the prominent brigade gets tangled up approaching the straight
scenarios.body: The pace will be true throughout with late acceleration suiting closers who avoid the mid-race squeeze. Snellen and Princess Child can time their runs to perfection while the prominent runners compromise each other.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Signora Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Signora faces no sustained challenge and the field allows her soft sectionals
scenarios.body: She can build an unassailable lead while the field marks each other, with her 3yo weight allowance proving decisive in the closing stages. The prominent horses will close but too late to catch her.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Royal
scenarios.trigger: If City Of Memphis or Carla Ridge challenge Signora early and force stronger sectionals
scenarios.body: The pace will collapse in the final furlong favoring those who raced prominently and maintained good position throughout. Quebec and Duckadilly can benefit from being handy without getting involved in early battles.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If no horse challenges Signora at any stage and the field crawls through moderate fractions
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class and tactical speed matter most, potentially suiting any horse with a turn of foot. Princess Child's class could shine in a slowly-run affair.

races.paceDynamic: Alcantor stands as the only confirmed front runner in this small field and will dictate proceedings from the outset without pressure. Excellent Believe, Mutasarref, Mississippi River and Catalina Delcarpio will track in behind as prominent racers, while Lord Massusus, Omni Man and Tokenomics adopt hold-up tactics from the rear. With just one pacemaker, Alcantor can control the tempo and slow the gallop down, creating a tactical affair that builds to a sprint finish. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can unleash a late kick, as the honest pace will leave plenty in reserve for the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Alcantor dictates a steady tempo without early pressure from the prominent group
scenarios.body: The race becomes tactical with plenty left for a sprint finish, allowing the hold-up horses to close strongly in the final two furlongs. The patient riders benefit as horses with finishing speed can sweep past the leaders who controlled the early pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Duel Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Excellent Believe or Mutasarref challenge Alcantor early to force the pace
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and creates an end-to-end gallop that suits horses with sustained speed rather than pure finishing kicks. The prominent racers who can travel strongly maintain their advantage to the line.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Alcantor Wire to Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the front runner gets an uncontested lead and quickens approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: After 218 days off, Alcantor uses his class and fitness from the O'Brien stable to steal a march on his rivals who leave their runs too late. The hold-up horses find the winner has flown when they launch their challenges.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the small field crawls early with nobody willing to commit until very late
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the two-furlong marker, favouring horses with instant acceleration over sustained finishing speed. The tactically sharp jockeys who position closest to the pace hold the advantage.

watchPoints.text: Alcantor faces significant fitness test after 218 days off, which could see him tire if asked to work hard from the front

The lack of genuine early pace will result in a sprint finish over the final 2-3 furlongs as the field remains tightly packed turning for home. This sustainable pace setup strongly favours horses with tactical speed and finishing kick over pure stamina.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If James J Braddock dictates comfortable fractions and the field stays bunched
scenarios.body: The race becomes a 3-furlong dash where class and acceleration matter most. Pierre Bonnard's Group 1 winning form and Endorsement's consistent placed efforts at this level give them the edge.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.trigger: If James J Braddock quickens turning for home before the closers react

scenarios.label: C

The prominent runners Beatific, Pink Coral and Johanna Walsh will track behind in the first half, while hold-up horses Believed, Wedding and Jerpoint Abbey sit further back. This measured tempo will allow the pace to build gradually through the middle stages before accelerating in the final three furlongs. This race shape strongly favours prominent trackers and hold-up horses who can finish strongly, as the uncontested early leader may not have enough tactical speed to respond when challenged.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady until the final 3f then quickens substantially
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up runners will have too much finishing kick for the early leaders as Believed, Wedding and Jerpoint Abbey can all produce their best work late. Zitkala Sa's lack of tactical pace will be exposed when the real running begins.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the middle stages see gradual acceleration from the 6f pole
scenarios.body: Beatific and Johanna Walsh can capitalise on their ideal stalking positions to strike when Zitkala Sa begins to weaken. Their superior class ratings give them the edge over the hold-up horses in a more evenly-run contest.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Stays
scenarios.trigger: If no serious challenges materialise until very late in the race
scenarios.body: Zitkala Sa benefits from the soft lead and has enough left in the tank to resist the late closers. The lack of early pressure allows her to dictate terms throughout and find extra when asked.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the debutant fillies show significant ability on their first starts
scenarios.body: The four newcomers with unknown ratings possess hidden talent that overwhelms the exposed runners. Their freshness and potential class advantage becomes apparent in the final stages.

races.paceDynamic: Bay Of Stars will likely set a moderate pace from the front with little early pressure, given he's the only confirmed pace-setter in this field of predominantly hold-up horses. The tempo should be sustainable through the early stages, allowing the large contingent of back-runners including Eniac, Chestnut Palace, Darius Dark, Divine Believer, Servare, Pass The Buck, Dreoilin and Keepsgettingbetter to settle well off the pace. With eight hold-up horses needing room to manoeuvre in the final three furlongs, this creates a tactical bottleneck that will favour horses who can secure good positions early or those with superior acceleration. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and front-runners who avoid the late traffic, while hold-up horses face significant tactical risks despite their numerical advantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Bay Of Stars gets an easy lead with minimal early pressure
scenarios.body: The pace will be too slow to expose his stamina limitations, and he can dictate terms before the hold-up brigade can organize their challenges. With such a soft lead, he becomes very hard to peg back despite giving weight away.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Erupts
scenarios.trigger: If the large group of hold-up horses encounter interference in the straight
scenarios.body: The numerical disadvantage of pace-setters becomes an advantage as Bay Of Stars avoids the melee behind. Those with early pace like Eniac who can position closer to the leaders will benefit most from the resulting traffic problems.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapses Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Bay Of Stars goes too fast early under pressure from Eniac tracking closer
scenarios.body: The front-runner will tie up in the final furlong, allowing the best of the hold-up horses to sweep past. Chestnut Palace and Dreoilin, with their solid recent form, are best positioned to capitalize.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Perfect Hold-Up Storm
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is moderate but the hold-up horses get clear runs simultaneously
scenarios.body: The sheer quality and depth of closers will overwhelm Bay Of Stars despite his tactical advantage. This requires everything to fall right for the back-markers, which is unlikely given the numbers involved.

Eniac's ability to race closer to pace than typical hold-up horses gives tactical edge
